title: EvidenceChainItem
description: One evidence-chain row produced by attach_evidence. ALL listed required fields MUST be present with real values. Missing ANY required field → attach_evidence MUST BLOCK. Do not invent threshold, rule_id, conclusion, or confidence.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold actually used by the fired rule. MUST NOT be invented for unknown metrics.

rule_id.description: Id of the default or configured rule, e.g. rule.crack_mm.gt_3. Missing rule_id → BLOCK.

conclusion.description: Grounded conclusion derived only from value vs threshold and rule_id. Never hallucinate.

confidence.description: Confidence in [0, 1] from the rule engine, not a guessed narrative score.
